name: music-sync
title: Music sync
description: Finds where a music starts inside a video's sound, so a better copy of the music can replace it.

findOffset.title: Find where the music starts
findOffset.description: Tells how late a music starts on a video's timeline by comparing the two sounds, however different their quality. Give the number to media.replaceAudio as offsetMs to put a high-quality copy of the music in the video.

video.description: The video, or any sound, that carries the music in low quality.

music.description: The music in good quality: a sound file or a video.

minScoreSigma.description: How far the best match must stand out from chance. Below it the call fails with 422 (no match), so a wrong music is never put in a video.

minOverlapMs.description: The least the two sounds must share.

offsetMs.description: How late the music starts on the video's timeline, in milliseconds. Negative when the video starts partway into the music. Give it to media.replaceAudio as offsetMs.

score.description: How far the match stands out from chance, in standard deviations (a real copy scores in the hundreds or more; unrelated music can reach about 15).

overlapMs.description: How much of the music lies inside the video.

driftMs.description: How much the offset changes from the start to the end of what they share. About 0 for a copy at the same speed; a larger number means the video was sped up or slowed down and one offset cannot line it up everywhere. Null when the shared stretch is too short to tell.

failures.description: A param is wrong or video or music is missing.
A sound is longer than 30 minutes.
No match (not the same music), the sounds are silent, or a file is not a sound this plugin can read.
